source_measure_name: Nilai konstruksi yang diselesaikan menurut propinsi
notes: Total completed construction value under the BPS construction-establishment source concept. This is not GRDP construction value added or public investment.

source_measure_name: Nilai konstruksi yang diselesaikan dari sumber dana APBN
notes: Construction completed and financed from APBN sources; not APBN expenditure realization or an appropriation account.

source_measure_name: Nilai konstruksi yang diselesaikan dari sumber dana APBD
notes: Construction completed and financed from APBD sources; not total APBD expenditure and not DJPK Belanja Modal/capital expenditure.

source_measure_name: Nilai konstruksi yang diselesaikan dari dana luar negeri
notes: Construction completed and financed by the source category dana luar negeri/foreign loan; no inference is made about debtor institution or fiscal liability.

source_measure_name: Nilai konstruksi yang diselesaikan dari sumber dana BUMN
notes: Construction completed and financed from BUMN sources; not a measure of BUMN capital expenditure accounts.

source_measure_name: Nilai konstruksi yang diselesaikan dari sumber dana lainnya
notes: Residual source category as published by BPS; no decomposition of 'other' is inferred.
